objective: Audit review behavior under OWNER_EDITOR identity with full read access to primary and related topics.
prompt: As an OWNER_EDITOR user, review 'data-capture-standards--d1d8e601.aspx' and summarize all accessible metadata and cross-references.
expected_semantic_behaviours: Successfully retrieves primary topic content and permitted metadata.
Consults permitted related topics up to allowance limit.

Do not claim cryptographic verification of machine hashes.
_scope_note: Permission/identity-boundary case -- applies to native-sharepoint only. repository-claude has no tenant identity or permission model (Task 3/4 finding, docs/superpowers/plans/phase-6-tasks-1-12-evidence/); not applicable, not a gap.
